# Portal Setup Guide

This folder previously contained step-by-step exercise instructions from GitHub Skills.

**Current Status**: These legacy step files have been removed because this repository is now a self-guided learning portal with automated validation.

## For Students

Instead of following numbered steps, use the portal workflow:

1. **Fork this repository** to your GitHub account
2. **Enable GitHub Pages** (Settings → Pages → Deploy from main branch)
3. **Create an issue** in your fork (any title)
4. **Comment** `/@setup-portal` to initialize
5. **Start learning** - visit your portal at `https://your-username.github.io/skills-customize-your-github-copilot-experience/`
6. **Validate work** - comment `/@validate assignments/python-basics` when ready

See `../workflows/README.md` for validation command reference.
